title: BambuStudio has been violating PrusaSlicer AGPL license since their fork
summary: PrusaSlicer creator Josef Prusa accuses BambuStudio of violating the AGPL license since their fork of the open-source 3D printing slicer software. This appears to be a licensing compliance dispute in the 3D printing community.
problem_solved: Addresses potential open-source license violations when companies fork and modify AGPL-licensed software without proper compliance.
why_valuable: Highlights the importance of understanding and respecting open-source license obligations, especially regarding copyleft licenses like AGPL.
